title_en: Hot Toys’ New Lord Doom Collectible Figure Unveils a Striking Alternate Design for Robert Downey Jr.’s Menacing MCU Villain
summary_en: A new Hot Toys figure reveals a striking alternate costume for Robert Downey, Jr.'s Doctor Doom that almost appeared in Avengers: Doomsday.
body_en:
Hot Toys has revealed a new figure based on Robert Downey, Jr.'s Doctor Doom from Avengers: Doomsday . This newest figure is an especially interesting case, however, as it showcases a new costume based on unrevealed concept art from the film.
Check out the slideshow gallery below for a closer look at Hot Toys' Lord Doom figure:
Again, it doesn't appear that Downey will actually wear this costume in the film; this is merely based on concept art of an alternate look for the character. But it's certainly an interesting variation on the traditional Doom design. Like the previously revealed "Victor Von Doom" figure , this costume looks to be more of a formal wear situation, with Doom decked out in full Latverian military regalia and wearing a less imposing version of his mask.
Sideshow Collectibles hasn't yet put this figure up for preorder, so we don't have any details regarding pricing and release date. Like the Victor von Doom figure, we'd expect this to be an exclusive figure produced in limited quantities, so definitely RSVP on the Sideshow site if you're interested in picking one up.
In the meantime, you can find preorder links for Hot Toys' various other Avengers: Doomsday figures below:
For more on Avengers: Doomsday, check out the latest series of posters for the MCU sequel and see why Kevin Feige is claiming that Doom was always the plan for this movie .
